external_evidence_reviewed_before_outcom: Published Ross Island methods report repeated colony searches during breeding seasons.
Cape Bird was searched regularly through 2013 but only intermittently from 2014 onward.

The published resighting model assigns all model weight to a detection structure including reproductive-state-by-age plus colony, showing that detection is not exchangeable among all individual-state-colony combinations.
reason_for_amendment.risk: A conditional model of observed first-breeding colony can confound settlement choice with colony-specific and time-varying resighting probability if observation structure is ignored.

stable_colony_alternative_effects.purpose: Absorb time-stable colony differences in resighting probability and baseline settlement attractiveness.
stable_colony_alternative_effects.permutation_behavior: Held fixed while prior-year performance labels are permuted.

bird_post_2013_rule.rule: Exclude an entire first-breeding event when first_breeding_season >= 2014 and BIRD is present in the frozen candidate set.
bird_post_2013_rule.reason: Published methods describe Cape Bird resighting as intermittent after 2013; candidate-specific nondetection cannot be repaired by treating Bird as simply unchosen.

outcome_season_resight_day_proxy.raw_definition: For Ross colony c and first-breeding season y, count distinct Date values with at least one valid resight record at c in season y after excluding all rows belonging to the focal individual event.
outcome_season_resight_day_proxy.name: resight_days_c_y
outcome_season_resight_day_proxy.transform: z-standardize log1p(resight_days_c_y) across CROZ, ROYD and BIRD within outcome season y; call it E_c,y.
outcome_season_resight_day_proxy.all_three_requirement: All three Ross colonies must have at least one non-focal valid resight date in season y; otherwise the first-breeding event is excluded.
outcome_season_resight_day_proxy.model_role: E_c,y is a primary nuisance covariate for differential opportunity to observe first breeding.
outcome_season_resight_day_proxy.interpretation_boundary: This is a detection-effort proxy, not true search effort. The resight table records detections rather than a complete survey-day log, so E_c,y may also depend on abundance and bird availability.

season_mapping.rule: Observation dates in October-December map to breeding season start year = calendar year; January-March map to start year = calendar year - 1.
season_mapping.out_of_window: April-September records are not used to construct primary breeding-season state or detection proxy unless the public README or exact header metadata documents a different breeding-season convention before full outcome access.
season_mapping.rationale: Published Ross searches occur primarily November-January and the study labels austral seasons by their starting year.

choice_engine_v2.linear_predictor: beta_perf * performance_state + beta_natal * natal_colony_indicator + beta_size * log1p_colony_size + beta_effort * E_c,y + beta_royd * is_ROYD + beta_bird * is_BIRD
choice_engine_v2.permutation: Unchanged: permute only prior-year three-colony performance labels within performance year; chosen outcome, candidate set, natal, size, effort proxy and colony alternative effects remain fixed.
choice_engine_v2.information_gate: Unchanged except events failing the prospective detection-control eligibility rules are removed before the frozen event-count thresholds are evaluated.

prespecified_detection_sensitivity.name: date_observer_effort
prespecified_detection_sensitivity.conditional_on_exact_header: Run only if the exact resight CSV header contains Initials exactly as documented by the public README.
prespecified_detection_sensitivity.definition: Count distinct (Date, Initials) pairs with a valid non-focal resight at colony c in outcome season y, transform as within-season z(log1p(count)), and substitute for E_c,y.
prespecified_detection_sensitivity.role: Sensitivity only; cannot rescue a failed primary performance coefficient.
prespecified_detection_sensitivity.reason: Approximates observer-days while acknowledging that observer initials are not a formal effort log.

performance_precision_sensitivity.rule: Repeat the primary model requiring at least 40 rather than 20 interpretable banded breeders in every colony of the prior performance year.
performance_precision_sensitivity.role: Stricter sensitivity only; cannot rescue a failed primary analysis and may be non-estimable.

not_allowed: Do not use the total number of resight rows as the primary effort covariate because it is strongly abundance-dependent.
Do not infer zero search effort from zero resight rows without applying the fail-closed event exclusion.
Do not reintroduce Bird candidate events from 2014 onward based on observed outcomes.
Do not drop stable colony effects, the effort proxy, or the Bird censoring rule because they weaken significance.
Do not change the performance permutation or minimum-information thresholds.
interpretation_boundary: The V2 control reduces, but does not eliminate, detection bias; it is not a full multistate capture-recapture observation model.
A positive beta_perf remains a conditional settlement-choice association among observed prospectors, not an unbiased population-wide migration probability.
A null result cannot distinguish biological absence from residual observation-process limitations.
